text:
support_jess: FYI customer jdoe hitting intermittent 502/504s calling Hosted API for large-batch embeddings. They see ~5-10% of requests fail during bursts. Happening since ~17:40 UTC. Repro steps and logs below. Escalating because they are seeing production errors.

customer_jdoe: hey we batch 800-1200 texts in one request to /v1/embeddings, around 17:40 we got a bunch of 502s. curl example attached. No auth errors, auth token ok.

support_jess: curl they used:```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"embed-compact-v1","inputs":["text1","text2",...]}'
```

customer_jdoe: sample response when it fails: ``HTTP/2 502\ncontent-type: application/json\n{"error":"upstream connection reset"}``

eng_sre_mike: thanks. Can you drop trace-id from failing reply headers? any upstream latency around that time in traces?

customer_jdoe: trace-id: trace-zz-17. We only have client-side timings: avg latency 380ms on success, failures come back ~1200ms then 502.

eng_runtime_anya: likely gateway-level reset on long-lived connection. Do we see pool exhaustion on ingress? I'll check h2 pool metrics and envoy xDS.

eng_sre_mike: also check edge nginx/error logs for "upstream prematurely closed connection" and connection window errors. Could be h2 stream limit + backend `accept` slow path under burst.

oncall_bot: Incident INC-2026-314 created for triage (assigned: eng_sre_mike).

devex_sam: quick thought — recommend short-term workaround: reduce batch size to 200-250 or enable chunked requests + client-side retry (exponential backoff, max 3). Not ideal but lowers pressure.

support_jess: customer confirmed they can try splitting batches. They want a root cause though — this started after we rolled infra change earlier (connection pooling tweak last night).

eng_runtime_anya: pulling control plane changes now. Patch last night changed upstream keepalive idle timeout from 60s -> 10s for one shard. That could cause connection churn if clients reuse long-lived streams. If pool sizes also lowered, race happens under burst.

eng_sre_mike: can you confirm envoy log snippets? I see entries around 17:40:```
[2026-04-13T17:40:12.345Z] envoy upstream reset: remote_reset reason=connection_failure, upstream_connection_id=12345
[2026-04-13T17:40:12.347Z] envoy http2 conn close: stream_id=301 error_code=ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM
```

eng_runtime_anya: that ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM is our h2 refusal code from upstream when stream window/drain triggers. Matches pool/churn theory.

eng_sre_mike: immediate mitigation: revert the keepalive timeout change for the shard or increase h2 connection window. Also consider temporarily bumping per-host connection pool. I'll propose a quick rollback to 60s.

devex_sam: pinging customers' SDKs docs — we'll add a recommended batch cap in docs and a snippet for chunking/parallelism guidance.

support_jess: customer willing to test reduced batches now. Trying 250 batch now, will report if errors persist.

customer_jdoe: reduced to 250, so far steady for 10m. No 502s yet.

eng_runtime_anya: good sign. I'll queue rollback of the keepalive change to staging and schedule deploy rollback to prod with eng-sre coordination. ETA 30m.

eng_sre_mike: after rollback we should monitor h2 stream reset rate, envoy upstream resets, and 502/504 counts per shard. Add a temporary alert if 502s > 0.5% baseline.

oncall_bot: Status update posted to #incidents. Patch rollback scheduled in 28 minutes.

support_jess: summarizing actions: 1) customer to send confirm on reduced batch 2) eng_runtime to rollback keepalive tweak 3) eng_sre to monitor metrics and alert 4) devex to publish short-term batch guidance.

customer_jdoe: thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll keep testing.

eng_runtime_anya: follow-up note after rollback: if we still see resets, we need to look at upstream app accept queue saturating (model containers busy processing huge batch workloads) — might require autoscale tuning or queuing at the edge to avoid big head-of-line blocking.

eng_sre_mike: filing follow-on ticket to evaluate batching QoS: consider per-request token limit, request queue depth, and smarter routing to dedicated capacity for high-throughput customers.

support_jess: closing loop — will update customer once rollback is complete and monitor for 1 hour post-deploy. :thumbsup:
